question: What role did the WTO membership (1995) play in India's post-reform globalization strategy?

options.text: Deepened India's integration into global trade

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepened India's integration into global trade**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India became a member of the World Trade Organization (WTO) on **1 January 1995**, marking a significant milestone in its economic globalization strategy.
 
• The WTO membership facilitated **greater market access** for Indian goods and services, boosting exports significantly over the years.
